## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复新版 Codex 中普通 / Fast 选项消失的问题，兼容旧版布尔权限及新版分级速度权限结构。
- 按功能结构识别 Fast 逻辑，继续独立检测语言与 Ultra，减少因客户端版本号、资源文件名或压缩变量名变化而重新适配的需要。
- 保留官方速度权限限制和服务商能力判断；某一功能结构无法确认时仅停用对应适配。

- Fixed the missing Normal / Fast selector in newer Codex clients, supporting both the earlier boolean permission and the newer tier-access structure.
- Detect Fast by its functional structure and continue checking language and Ultra independently, reducing maintenance for version, asset-name and minifier-name changes.
- Preserve official service-tier restrictions and provider capability checks; an unrecognized feature falls back independently.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。保存当前工作、停止实例并退出旧管理器后安装新版，再重新启动实例以加载兼容修复。账号、实例与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Save your work, stop instances and quit the old manager before installing; restart instances to load the compatibility update. Accounts, instances and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code、Claude Desktop 及其他客户端仍为计划接入。Fast 的实际支持取决于模型及供应商；本版本不改变上游服务等级或赋予账号额外权限。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other clients remain planned integrations. Fast support depends on the model and provider; this release does not change upstream service tiers or grant additional account permissions.

源码对应标签 [`v0.4.7`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.7)，安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

Source corresponds to tag [`v0.4.7`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.7); installer checksums are in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
